metadata.question: Did the water extent in Sebkha el Melah (29.135547, -1.187011) increase between August 12, 2024, and September 29, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Sebkha el Melah at coordinates (29.135547, -1.187011) - this is in Morocco/Algeria border region - Two specific dates: August 12, 2024 and September 29, 2024 - Need water detection imagery - Sentinel-2 is ideal for water mapping - Create a buffer around the point to analyze the area 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using SCL band or QA60 for Sentinel-2 - Use water indices like NDWI or MNDWI to detect water extent - MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) is better for water bodies 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid Zero (B): Water extent decreased or stayed same (difference <= 0) - Valid Positive (A): Water extent increased (difference > 0) - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-1.187011, 29.135547]); const aoi = point.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around the point const date1 = '2024-08-12'; const date2 = '2024-09-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const s2_col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const s2_col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size1 = await s2_col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await s2_col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images on ${date1}: ${size1}`); console.log(`Images on ${date2}: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both dates."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate MNDWI and water extent function addMNDWI(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } function maskClouds(image) { const scl = image.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return image.updateMask(mask); } const img1 = s2_col1.map(maskClouds).map(addMNDWI).median(); const img2 = s2_col2.map(maskClouds).map(addMNDWI).median(); // Water threshold: MNDWI > 0 const water1 = img1.select('MNDWI').gt(0); const water2 = img2.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // 4. Calculation - Count water pixels const count1Stats = await water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: aoi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2Stats = await water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: aoi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels1 = count1Stats['MNDWI_sum']; const validPixels1 = count1Stats['MNDWI_count']; const waterPixels2 = count2Stats['MNDWI_sum']; const validPixels2 = count2Stats['MNDWI_count']; console.log(`${date1}: Valid pixels=${validPixels1}, Water pixels=${waterPixels1}`); console.log(`${date2}: Valid pixels=${validPixels2}, Water pixels=${waterPixels2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (validPixels1 === 0 || validPixels2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (waterPixels1 === null || waterPixels2 === null || waterPixels1 === undefined || waterPixels2 === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } const diff = waterPixels2 - waterPixels1; console.log(`Water extent change: ${diff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${diff.toFixed(0)} pixels`); if (diff > 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
